summary: WS-A overlay fix (commit 631918cb9) faithfully implements the locked design: a single shared read-only ~/.claude base at auth/_shared/claude-base/.claude (built once, build-to-temp + atomic os.replace, GC-safe location outside any auth/<id>), per-workspace writable upper/work chowned to 1000, and a merged overlay bind-mounted rw at /home/agent/.claude. The merged mount is excluded from the generic rw-chown walk while upper/work are chowned explicitly; overlay-unavailable falls back to the legacy full copy catching specific OSError/SubprocessError, logging CLAUDE_AUTH_OVERLAY_UNAVAILABLE and cleaning half-built scratch; teardown_workspace_auth_overlay unmounts-before-remove idempotently and surfaces real umount errors, wired into cli/common.py compose teardown with gc.py untouched; provider_readiness reports per_workspace_overlay/per_workspace_copy via claude_auth_isolation_label; local-service.yml adds cap_add SYS_ADMIN and the :rshared work-dir bind. All planned TDD tests exist (overlay happy path, base built-once/reused, base content+history-exclusion+dangling-symlink skip, isolation chowns only upper/work, fallback x3 cases, teardown x4, GC-safety location, isolation label, subprocess mounter, cli teardown, readiness parametrized). Scope discipline respected: forbidden files (gc.py, git_manager.py, lifecycle.py) untouched.
